name: 61107 · Rockford, IL
findings: ZIP 61107 (Rockford) has 158 nonprofit organizations. 54 of them (34%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 48 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (20% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 61107 (Rockford) has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.
26% of the organizations offering opportunities have no identified type, so the breakdown by type is partial.

observations.title: More organizations list volunteering
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 61107 (Rockford) list volunteering on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 1.6 times the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 27 organizations here; 34% of all organizations here have no identified type.
